newsitem.title: USA: Mobil intros new synthetic motor oil.
newsitem.headline: Mobil intros new synthetic motor oil.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Tuesday it added its lower viscosity Mobil 1 Extreme Formula 0W-30 to its line of Mobil 1 fully synthetic motor oils.
The formula is designed to provide engine protection over a wider temperature range, from 400 degrees Farenheit to 50 degrees Farenheit below zero, the company said.
This formula also flowed six times faster than conventional motor oils, the company said.

"This breakthrough development is especially beneficial for passenger vehicles -- both gasoline and diesel powered, that must perform under heavily-loaded driving conditions," said George Madden, general manager for the lubricants business.
